title: An agent's persona — settings/profile.json in its repository fabric-agent-<id>
description: agent-fabric ADR-056 §5 rule 1. Written by the agent itself, in one commit with settings/avatar.png and settings/avatar-rejected/, once it has accepted an avatar; never before. The surname is also recorded centrally in identities/personas/claims.json, which wins if the two disagree. Sex is for the avatar's appearance only (rule 6).

first_name.description: From the culture of the surname's `from` (rule 5).

surname.description: Exactly as listed in identities/personas/surnames.json and claimed in claims.json.

pronoun.description: Present only when the agent asked for one, e.g. "it" (rule 6).

accepted.description: The day the agent accepted its avatar.
